segments.en: Today I practise 计算机英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 命令行和终端 with a teammate. I use terminal to talk about 终端，用文字命令操作电脑的窗口. I use command line to talk about 命令行，输入和执行文本命令的环境. I use shell to talk about 命令解释器，读取并执行用户输入的命令. I tell my teammate: Today I use terminal, command line, and shell. At the end, I say: I can use terminal clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 预约与改期 with a teammate. I use make an appointment to talk about 进行预约. I use reschedule the meeting to talk about 重新安排会议时间. I use cancel an appointment to talk about 取消预约. I tell my teammate: Today I use make an appointment, reschedule the meeting, and cancel an appointment. At the end, I say: I can use make an appointment clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 预约与改期 with a teammate. I use confirm the time to talk about 确认时间. I use Does Tuesday work? to talk about 星期二方便吗？. I use I'm not available then. to talk about 我那时没有空。. I tell my teammate: Today I use confirm the time, Does Tuesday work?, and I'm not available then.. At the end, I say: I can use confirm the time clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 自动检查状态 with a teammate. I use status check to talk about 状态检查，自动判断提交是否满足要求. I use required check to talk about 必需检查，合并前必须通过的检查. I use pending check to talk about 等待中的检查，尚未产生结果. I tell my teammate: Today I use status check, required check, and pending check. At the end, I say: I can use status check clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 自动检查状态 with a teammate. I use passing check to talk about 通过的检查，自动验证成功. I use failed check to talk about 失败的检查，自动验证没有通过. I use check details to talk about 检查详情，显示自动任务的日志和结果. I tell my teammate: Today I use passing check, failed check, and check details. At the end, I say: I can use passing check clearly today.
